newsitem.title: USA: US stocks broadly battered by NAPM,at lower levels.
newsitem.headline: US stocks broadly battered by NAPM,at lower levels.

text.p: U.S. stocks were steady at lower levels in late morning after a report on December manufacturing activity spooked a bond market already on tenterhooks after some robust economic reports Tuesday.

At 1000 EST/1500 GMT the National Association of Purchasing Management index came in at 54.0, beating forecasts of 52.3. The data sparked a sell-off in bonds and erased early gains in the Dow, sending the blue chip index hurtling to a loss of about 96 points.
The Dow rebounded slightly and was off 45 to 6403.
